cat > /workdir/think.py <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time,json
import arena,chess
b=arena.load_board()
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def send(x):s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
for l in f:
 if l.startswith('uciok'):break
send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256')
send('isready')
for l in f:
 if l.startswith('readyok'):break
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
cmd='go movetime '+str(int(float(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 30)*1000))
if len(sys.argv)>2:cmd+=' searchmoves '+' '.join(sys.argv[2:])
send(cmd)
start=time.time()
for l in f:
 if l.startswith('info depth') or l.startswith('bestmove'): print(l.strip(),flush=True)
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):
  json.dump({'fen':b.fen(),'bestmove':l.split()[1], 'elapsed':time.time()-start},open('/workdir/best.json','w'));break
send('quit')
PY
